correctness.rationale: The RESULT.md proof identifies the unique principal-filter generator R_A(x) from consequent-meet preservation and Id, and obtains R_A(x) subseteq A; for x in A, P2 and MP force R_A(x)={x}, while R_empty(x)=empty. P5 is equivalent to R_D(x) subseteq union_{y in R_A(x)}R_D(y) for D subseteq A. At three atoms exactly six singleton free bits and three two-element fibers range over 4096 assignments, a complete finite search by this proved parametrization. Independently re-enumerated all configurations from the defining axioms/strong density and obtained exactly 1235 accepted operations, 283 with all fibers of cardinality <=1, 952 others, 35 fixed per transposition and 11 per 3-cycle; Burnside gives 227 isomorphism classes. One- and two-atom exhaustive instances gave 1 and 4 operations and no multivalued free fiber. This is exhaustive for n<=3 only, not a statement for all Boolean algebras.
